product: Walnut Markets helps self-directed investors find stocks worth investigating, understand why they rank, and track what happened afterward. Marketing: walnutmarkets.com. Product: app.walnutmarkets.com. US-listed market coverage for a global audience. This brief summarizes the founder-supplied product, audience and competitor documents; their proposed audience quotes and competitor claims are hypotheses, not verified customer research.
positioning: Find what deserves your attention. See why. Keep score. Sell a concrete stock-selection workflow and accountability, rather than more research, more dashboards, or abstract decision intelligence.
north_star: Qualified users who create an account, investigate a ticker, inspect its score drivers and return to review outcomes. Judge content by attributed activated signups and subsequent paid conversion, alongside viewing metrics.
audience_segments: Serious self-directed stock pickers; investors comparing alternative signals and fundamental context; strategy and backtest users; busy investors monitoring a portfolio. Prioritize one problem and one workflow in each video.
audience_pains: Too many opinions and disconnected tools. Unclear reasons behind scores. Hard to separate bullish evidence from disagreement. Stock calls rarely come with transparent follow-through. The supplied audience quotations are founder projections, not testimonials.
desired_outcomes: A shortlist worth investigating, reasons the investor can explain, visible risks and conflicting signals, and a dated record of what happened after the original call.
competitors: Founder brief references Finviz, TradingView, Quiver Quantitative and broader research tools. Use these as positioning inputs only. Verify current competitor pricing, functionality and comparisons independently before public claims; the supplied material contains inconsistent feature descriptions.
differentiation: Show the actual integrated workflow: ticker chart, Confirmation Score and its drivers, cross-source disagreement, risks, then dated Outcomes. Demonstrate product details rather than unsupported claims of superiority.
features: Confirmation Score is 0–100 with a 30-day outlook. Inspect drivers, conflicts and risks. Outcomes supports multiple review horizons; only demonstrate horizons actually visible in the recorded product. Strategies is Live Beta. Do not promote Options Flow, API/webhooks, Research Memory or real-time coverage as available without checking their current released status.
pricing: Founder-supplied pricing: Free $0 with no credit card; Premium $24.95/month or $249.50/year; Pro $39.95/month or $399.95/year. Reverify before price-led ads. Free-account CTA must not imply all demonstrated Premium features are free.
brand_voice: Natural, confident male founder, as explicitly selected by the owner. Conversational, curious, concise and specific. One continuous narrated take with natural punctuation. Confident about the workflow, measured about investments. Premium visual taste without wealth promises.
prohibited_language: No guaranteed returns, secret trades, smart money knows, fabricated testimonials, invented traction, unverified competitor claims, or promises that a video will go viral. No performance claim without source, timeframe, benchmark, methodology and relevant limitations. Do not claim generated lifestyle backgrounds depict an actual customer or investment outcome.
preferred_language: Show me why. Look behind the score. Check both sides. What happened next? Find what deserves your attention. See why. Keep score.
content_principles: One recognizable investing problem, one coherent message, real Walnut product proof, one CTA. Match spoken claims to the screen being shown. Actual moving ticker captures, tight component crops, readable synchronized phrase captions, original restrained finance-lifestyle imagery. Keep source dates and captured text attached to each shot. Never redraw numbers or fabricate product UI.
growth_opportunities: Test three hooks around the same product demonstration: NVIDIA opinions, explaining a score, and accountability for previous calls. Use real Search Console queries to rank future topics when available; do not label an editorial idea as search-demand validated. Connect UTM-tagged content to landing sessions, signup completion and first meaningful product action.
action_plan: First produce and review the NVIDIA Show Me Why ad. Test the three hooks separately with comparable audience, placement and spend. Evaluate initial hold, average watch time, completion, profile/link actions, landing conversion and activated signups. Preserve unsuccessful experiments and feedback. Publish only after owner review. No automated paid spend.
successful_examples: HeyCatch references inspected in September 2026 have more immediate lifestyle/personality motion than Walnut's first prototype. This is a creative reference, not evidence of successful conversion. Instagram DdD5XDWE9SS: 113 views, 102 viewers, 98.2% non-followers, zero likes/comments/saves/shares and zero profile activity at inspection. TikTok 7682469159460015380: 227 views, 3 likes, zero comments/saves at inspection.
rejected_examples: Owner rejected V1 quality: incoherent script; mentions NVIDIA without showing its actual ticker; bland screenshots; static text for too long; robotic scene-by-scene voice. Improve message, footage and delivery before scaling content volume. Owner declined the Creatomate paid upgrade; retain its trial and use the existing worker for native full-resolution rendering.
platform_instructions: 9:16 vertical, 1080×1920 native export, important text inside interface-safe margins, sound plus captions, recognizable product proof early, and a single clear CTA. Use licensed or original assets. Do not copy HeyCatch videos or assume views equal signups. Keep every result in review until explicitly approved.
tiktok: Natural founder-style delivery and a product-related opening hook. Show active screen exploration quickly. Test question, score-explanation and accountability hooks. Inspect retention and downstream actions rather than chasing generic finance memes.
instagram: Premium restrained visual styling, real product motion and captions that work with sound off. Existing sampled reel reached mostly non-followers but produced no visible profile actions; test stronger product proof and an explicit account-creation CTA. No claim about bounce rate or watch retention from the limited insights inspected.
